en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-18 According to the same documentation, God’s Prophet (S) said,

"Allah, Blessed and Exalted, says:
O son of Adam, you do not treat Me justly.
I draw near to you with blessings, while you draw near to Me with sins.
My goodness descends upon you, and your evil rises up to Me.
And yet, a noble angel comes to Me from you every day and night with an ugly deed.
O son of Adam, if you were to hear your description from anyone else, not knowing that it was about you, you would rush to despise him."
